scope: Independent read-only review of root GPU methodology and current P13 implementation/test policies. Not new gameplay evidence or whole-iteration approval.

gpu.timing: Actual asynchronous EXT GPU queries on separate native WebGL2 and Phaser WebGL1 contexts. Original draw calls run normally; no gl.finish, disjoint samples discarded and query handles deleted. All six severe samples remained alive for over 60 seconds.
gpu.cpuScope: Phaser Game.js emits POST_STEP before renderer.preRender/render/postRender. The cpu field measures update CPU, excluding Phaser render submission and compositor work.
gpu.gpuScope: Do not add independent context quantiles as wall-time; one Apple M4 Pro/Chrome154 reference machine, entry-area real movement, not deep-combat or second-hardware approval.
gpu.allocation: GPU-process root size counted once. Shared-image Gles2 mailbox subtotal is not all private ANGLE allocations or exclusive resident physical VRAM.
gpu.mixedGrowth: Final mixed-return root growth includes ANGLE +4751360 bytes, Dawn +410588, shared_images +4332800, transfer_memory +13303808, transfer_cache +17376. It is not purely compositor cache. Root is taking bounded repeated mixed-return dumps before final resource interpretation.

p13.sourceChanges: Only first two authored growth prices 8/9→4/6 and severe deep kindling 3×4→2×6. Later 20 prices unchanged; low/medium numeric budgets unchanged. New definition2/revision3 frozen independently of r1/r2.

p13.naturalPolicy: Prepared natural explicitly rejects controlled world/build/identity fixtures. Equipment/offering uses public presenter facts. Severe targets must have been seen; the distant exploration target reads physical floor geometry, not hidden contents.
limits: Full-map macro terrain routing is disclosed and differs from novice navigation.
Two independent new saves plus one disclosed mature branch are not three independent origins.
